title: One Bag
audience: DRAFT, confirm or rewrite: my family and the friends who also left home to study. They watch on a phone, mostly in vertical.
intent: DRAFT, confirm or rewrite: they should feel that fear at the start of something new is normal, and that it passes.

characters.label: The author in 2019
characters.description: A slim Ethiopian young man of about nineteen with short black hair, wearing a plain dark jacket over a light shirt, carrying one worn canvas shoulder bag.
characters.reference_prompt: Character sheet on a plain warm background: the same young man shown three times, from the front, from the side and from behind, full figure, neutral pose, with his canvas shoulder bag.

characters.label: The author today

music.caption: Slow, sparse instrumental. A solo krar (Ethiopian lyre) plucks a gentle pentatonic melody in the tizita mood, a soft washint flute answers, warm low drone underneath. Intimate room sound, nostalgic and tender, a lot of space between notes. No drums, no vocals.

Low drone enters under the taxi ride.
Tension: the melody thins out, the drone grows.
Back to the krar alone. The room.
Flute enters. A lift, he gets on the bus.
The first melody returns and resolves. Fade under the end card.
